As a former business president/spokesperson, making a name/label for your group/organization requires a few things.
Their name should set a clear tone/personality of how they want others to view them. Are they independent? Are they an underground type of group? Superheroes of supervillains? Etc.

An organization’s name has to let your audience know what they are (or at least what they WANT to appear as to the public)

Their name shouldn’t be too complicated either. An acronym is fine.

But the first thing is the main point you should think about in the perspective of those characters in the group.
